pages.title: Tumour Hydra
pages.text: $(thing)Tumour Hydra$(): A mound of overgrown tissue as wide as a house, with heads on long necks growing out of every side. Its body only walks to keep the heads in reach; the heads bite. Strike a head or anywhere along its neck: every 30 damage cuts that head off (a blow to the body is mostly soaked up). The stump stays where the head was, open for five seconds: seal it with fire, or strike it with a CAR-T Cell Culture or an Apoptosis Trigger, and that head is gone for good; leave it, and it grows back with another beside it. With no heads left, blows to the body land in full and it can be killed. Its bite carries Metastasis. Called with a Metastatic Spore on open ground in the Tumour of Inner Space.$(br2)$(thing)Drops$(): Tumour Specimen, Immortal Cell Line, Metastatic Spore.
